scenario: LTIM.4.3.1 / LGRA.9.6.2: `add_months` and `add_years` are members of `Time` and `Date` only; on a `Duration` receiver `.add_months(1)` names no member, so it is DS_VALIDATE_UNKNOWN_MEMBER, and a span is added with `+`. Drives `lgra_9_6_2_member_call` in dsc.typecheck: `member_with_arguments` has no `Duration` row for the name, so `unknown_member` answers.
rules_ds:
schema Ev scope logical:
    id: Int key
    span: Duration mutable

rule r:
    Ev e
->
    let later = e.span.add_months(1)
    log info "{later}"
